g.title: User enters https://www.worldklems.net/
The ConfigMap provides the NGINX configuration
The Deployment creates and maintains the Pod
Django / Wagtail stores uploaded media and documents in JuiceFS
Django / Wagtail reads and updates site data in MariaDB
WhiteNoise serves CSS, JavaScript and other static assets
DNS converts the domain name to an IP address
Docker build produces a deployable image
The image is pushed to the Harbor registry
Docker build follows the instructions in the Dockerfile
Docker build uses the application source from the Git repository
Gunicorn runs the Django / Wagtail application
The Deployment points to the image stored in Harbor
Ingress accepts the HTTPS request and passes it into the cluster
Django / Wagtail reads stored media and documents from JuiceFS
JuiceFS returns the media file so NGINX can serve it
kubectl applies the desired Kubernetes configuration
MariaDB returns the requested data to Django / Wagtail
NGINX passes dynamic requests to Gunicorn
For /media/, NGINX asks JuiceFS for the requested file
From source code to running public website
Rancher lets administrators inspect and manage the deployment
Kubernetes Secrets provide credentials to the web application
Service forwards the request to the NGINX container
